carmen: Quick update
bout Marlin11B-int4 bring-up. Benchmarks look good on throughput and cost, but we reproducibly see quality drift on multi-paragraph research summaries and multi-hop Q&A. Need a short cost-vs-quality brief + a conservative routing plan for GTN.

li: Microbench numbers from infra: sustained 210 tok/s/GPU, p50 130ms, p95 460ms at 1k context. Rough unit cost = 0.34x vs our 13b-int8 baseline. Equivalent cost ~ $24 / 1M tokens (int4) vs ~$71 baseline.

noah: Eval snapshot (45k mixed-slice harness):
- small-chat (support): accept-rate delta -0.2%
- research-summary (3-8 para): surrogate-metric -4.5, human-flag 5.8%
- multi-hop Q&A (chain-of-thought): exact-match -2.6%, hallucination-upswing on 2-hop cases

sabrina: Runtime note: quant noise shows up as slight token-prob smoothing after long decodes -> more occasional verbatim repetitions and citation drift for long outputs. KV retention tuning helps but increases memory pressure on canary hosts.

carmen: Compact scorecard we can show PMs:
```
Model: Marlin11B-int4
Slices: small-chat | research-summary | multi-hop-qa
Quality delta vs baseline: -0.2% | -4.5% | -2.6%
Latency p95 (1k ctx): 460ms | 700ms (tail, kv churn) | 480ms
Unit-cost: ~0.34x baseline
Product-risk: Low | High | Medium-High
```

li: Economic bullets (rounded):
- Unit cost multiplier: 0.34x baseline (66% savings per token)
- Example impact: 120k DAU * 900 tokens/day * (1 - 0.34) -> ~98M tokens/day saved -> ~$2.35k/day saved (~$71k/mo) at L0 rates
- Operational note: expect an uptick in human-review and SRE triage for research summaries until kv tuning lands.

noah: Product wants absolute flag counts if we route 20% of traffic. Assume research-summary is 5% of total requests.

carmen: Back-of-envelope calc: extra_flags_abs = routing_pct * flag_rate * slice_share = 0.2 * 0.058 * 0.05 = 0.00058 -> 0.058% absolute increase overall -> ~0.58 flags per 1k requests. For 1M requests/day that'd be ~580 additional flagged responses/day. We'll surface both per-1k and per-day numbers to GTN.

sabrina: Quick mitigations we can implement before wider rollout:
- kv-pin windows for canary hosts to reduce evictions
- max_gen caps on research-summary slice (e.g., 1.2k tokens)
- lightweight in-line reranker to detect citation drift (rerank_score threshold 0.68 fallback to baseline)
- targeted eval sweep on 2-hop chains to calibrate fallbacks

li: Proposed conservative rollout for GTN messaging and ops config:
1) Canary: 3% live traffic restricted to small-chat and FAQ slices only.
2) Shadow: 30% of research-summary traffic for 72h with prioritized human labels.
3) Holdback: keep research-summary holdback at 90% until human-flag rate < 2% for 48h.
4) Ramp: if slice regressions < 2% and kv-tail incidents < 0.5%/hour, expand to 25% for low-risk slices.
5) Fallback: requests with rerank_score < 0.68 OR repeat-detect true -> route to baseline.

noah: Ops config snippet (copyable):
```
canary:
  percent: 3
  allowed_slices: [small-chat, faq]
shadow:
  percent: 30
  slice: research-summary
holdback:
  research-summary: 90%  # keep most traffic on baseline until tuned
fallback_policy:
  rerank_threshold: 0.68
  fallback_model: baseline-13b-int8
monitoring:
  research_flag_alert: 2%_1h
  kv_tail_alert: 0.5%_1h
```

sabrina: One-line recommended blurb for GTN: "Marlin11B-int4 cuts per-token spend by ~66% with negligible short-chat regressions but meaningful regressions on long research summaries; recommend conservative canary + aggressive shadowing and a 90% holdback for summaries until targeted tuning reduces flags."

carmen: Short risk table for PMs (single slide):
- Cost upside: High (~0.34x unit cost)
- Short-chat: Minimal regression
- Research-summary: Material regressions (~5.8% flags) -> holdback/shadowing required
- Multi-hop QA: Moderate regressions -> reranker + eval sweep recommended
- Ops burden: Moderate-High (KV tuning + human labeling cadence)

ops-bot: Canary cluster allocated: canary-marlin11b-2026-03-23. Runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/marlin11b-canary

li: Can someone prep a one-slide scorecard + absolute flag math for GTN by EOD? PMs want a TL;DR and the per-1k/1M numbers.

carmen: I'll assemble the slide and include raw eval CSV and the per-day counts. Ping me if you want extra slices added. :thumbsup:
